question.content:
Chana and Josiah started skating at the same time in the same direction, but Josiah had a head start $10$ meters past the starting line. Chana skated $3$ meters per second and Josiah skated $2$ meters per second.

Here's a graph that shows a system of equations for this scenario where $x$ is the number of seconds since Chana and Josiah started skating and $y$ is the distance in meters from the starting line.

![A graph with two lines and a point. Line A is labeled y equals 10 plus 2 times x. Line B is labeled y equals 3 times x. Point I is on line B and below line A.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/5f2900ae7e5ecb3f1719eaf7f0a6e0444ccae615)

**What does point $I$ represent in this context?**

[[☃ radio 1]]

choices.clue: Point $I$ is on line $b$, so it does represent Chana's distance at a certain time. Also, point $I$ is below line $a$, so it represents a distance that is less than Josiah's distance.
choices.content: Chana's distance from the starting line at a time when she is behind Josiah

choices.clue: Point $I$ is on line $b$, so it represents Chana's distance at a certain time.
